Evelyn Park: Hi all — newbie question: what's the cleanest rule for where to post things in week 1? e.g., broken laptop, account access, product q's, quick FYIs. Also any non-annoying way to silence bot churn but still catch real alerts?

Jordan M.: Welcome! Short rules I use: 1) Access/setup -> #help with this template: Name / Team / Resource / Urgency. 2) Infra/deploy -> #eng-infra and include exact error text. 3) Product/context -> #product. 4) Small team FYIs -> post in your team channel and always "reply in thread" for back-and-forth so the channel stays scannable.

Riya N.: On reactions vs replies: react for ack or quick thanks (:thumbsup:), reply when you need an action or follow-up. Saves a lot of noise. If a thread gets >3 replies, move it to a dedicated channel or create a short doc.

Evelyn Park: How do you mute bots without losing pages? DeployBot is spammy.

DevEx Bot: Hi Evelyn :wave: — recommended: channel > View apps > DeployBot > set "only notify on failures". For onboarding digests run `/onboard subscribe-digest` to get a DM instead of channel posts. Never mute #eng-oncall or the @oncall role. You can also set personal keywords (your name, "pager") so only important things ping you.

Jordan M.: Pro tip: use channel pins/bookmarks for onboarding links so new posts don't bury them. Also use DND (`/dnd`) for focus blocks and set a visible status so people know when you'll reply.

OnboardBot: Welcome! If you'd like a buddy for setup reply "buddy please" and we'll match you, or run `/onboard assign-buddy`. Onboarding docs: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/slack-guide.

Evelyn Park: Thanks!! I'll post access stuff in #help and infra stuff in #eng-infra. Buddy please :)

Riya N.: I'll DM you in 10 to help with SSH keys and Docker.

Evelyn Park: Appreciate it :heart:
